usage.bench: orbit-mem bench recall --cases <file> [--db <memory DB>] [--recall current,legacy] [--split all|train|test] [--json] [--report <file>] | bench extract [--projects <dir>] [--db <memory DB>] [--out <dir>] [--min-sessions N] [--min-requests N]   # recall evaluation set · replay material from Claude Code logs (outside the repository)
flag.bench.db: memory DB to measure on (not written; a copy is used). Needed when the case file has no memories
flag.bench.recall: recall paths, comma separated: current, legacy
flag.bench.split: part shown in the text: all, train or test (JSON always has all)
flag.bench.report: write the report with the result of every case (ids shown, characters, top 8 of find) to this file
flag.bench.projects: Claude Code projects folder to read
flag.bench.out: folder to write memory-copy.db, sessions.json and cases.json (not inside a git working tree)
cli.bench.db_both: the case file has memories: do not give --db
cli.bench.db_needed: the case file has no memories: --db is needed
cli.bench.similar: Similar (duplicate bundle): %s, a stand-in memory_find over the draft
cli.bench.out_in_repo: --out is inside a git working tree (%s): choose a folder outside the repository
cli.bench.no_sessions: no session with a request was found in the projects folder
cli.bench.extract_done: written to %s: sessions %d, requests %d, delegations %d, tool cases %d
bench.report.test_size: test part: answered requests %d (one case %.1f%%p), left empty %d (%.1f%%p), delegations %d (%.1f%%p), duplicates %d (%.1f%%p)
bench.report.wrong: wrong recall %s | injected %d = right %d + neutral %d + wrong %d | forbid %d (cases %d)
bench.report.recover: miss recovery %s | every case without a hit %s
bench.report.subagent: delegations %d hit %s | wrong recall %s | forbid %d | left empty %s | characters %s
bench.report.duplicate: duplicates %d hit %s | offered when none should be %s | forbid %d
